Mutation Name: Mutation 1: Query missing tenant filter in application layer
Description: Application query omits WHERE tenant_id = :tenant_id clause in document operations.

Mutation Name: Mutation 2: RLS policy with condition flipped
Description: PostgreSQL RLS policy uses 'tenant_id != current_setting(...)' allowing cross-tenant rows.

Mutation Name: Mutation 3: RLS not enabled on documents table
Description: Documents table has ROW LEVEL SECURITY disabled or unforced.

Mutation Name: Mutation 4: Application connecting as role with BYPASSRLS
Description: Application connects using a database role granted the BYPASSRLS privilege.

Mutation Name: Mutation 5: Tenant context leaking through connection pooling
Description: Tenant context set at session level (is_local=false) with pool_size=1, leaking context across checkouts.
